user.title: Connect to GoSMS RU
user.description:
Enter your GoSMS RU API key. You can create one at [my.gosms.ru](https://my.gosms.ru) → API Integration → Create Key.

Make sure the key has **devices:read** and **sms:send** permissions.

data_description.api_key: Your GoSMS RU API key (starts with gosms_…)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate GoSMS RU
reauth_confirm.description: Your GoSMS RU API key is no longer valid (expired or revoked). Create a new key at [my.gosms.ru](https://my.gosms.ru) → API Integration and enter it below.

data_description.api_key: Your new GoSMS RU API key (starts with gosms_…)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to GoSMS RU API. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key. Please check the key and its permissions.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

send_sms.name: Send SMS
send_sms.description: Send an SMS message via GoSMS RU using your connected Android device. The message is sent through your SIM card at your carrier's rate.

phone.name: Phone number
phone.description: Recipient phone number in international format (e.g. +79001234567).

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: UUID of the specific GoSMS RU device to send from. Leave empty to let GoSMS RU pick any available online device automatically.

no_store.name: Message history
no_store.description: Whether to save the sent SMS in GoSMS RU history. "Don't save" sends the message directly to the device — delivery status will not be tracked.
